meta.title: BỘ DỰ ĐOÁN ĐỀ THI IELTS SPEAKING QUÝ 3
meta.subtitle: (THÁNG 9 - THÁNG 12) NĂM 2026
meta.author: BY NGOCBACH

compulsory.title: 1. Where you live now
questions: Which town or city do you live in now?
Are there any things you don't like about your area? (What are they?)
Do you think you will continue to live there for a long time? (Why? Why not?)
What are some changes in the area recently?
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favourite room in your home? (Why?)
What things make your home pleasant to live in? (Why?)
Are the people in your neighbourhood nice and friendly?
Do you know any of your neighbours?
Do you know any famous people in your area?

compulsory.title: 2. Work / Study
questions: (Work)
What kind of work do you do?
What do you find most interesting about your work? (Why?)
Which is more important to you – the people you work with or the work you do? (Why?)
Do you work best in the morning or the afternoon? (Why?)
(Study)
What do you study?
What do you find most interesting about your studies? (Why?)
Which is more important to you – the teachers or the other students on your course? (Why?)
How much time do you spend studying every week?
How do you usually travel to the city where you study?
Do you study best in the morning or the afternoon? (Why?)
Have you always wanted to study this subject / these subjects? (Why? Why not?)

specific.title: 1. Computers / Tablets
questions: In what conditions would you use a computer?
When was the first time you used a computer?
In what conditions would it be difficult for you to use a computer?

specific.title: 2. Collecting things
questions: Do you collect things?
Are there any things you keep from childhood?
Where do you usually keep things you need?

specific.title: 3. Street market
questions: Are street markets common in your country?
What is usually sold there?
Do you think people like street markets? Why?

specific.title: 4. Travelling
questions: Do you like to travel?
Do you often travel by air?
How long was the longest trip you took?
Which country would you like to travel to in the future?
Would you like to travel to space?

specific.title: 5. Paper / Writing letters
questions: Do you often write things?
Do you prefer to write by hand or write using a computer?
Do you think computers might one day replace handwriting?
When do children begin to write in your country?

specific.title: 6. Losing things / Lost and found
questions: Do you always bring a lot of keys with you?
Have you ever lost your keys?

specific.title: 7. Being polite / Politeness
questions: How did you learn to be polite as a child?
Do you think being polite is very important?
Who taught you to be polite when you were young?

specific.title: 8. Shoes
questions: What's your favorite type of shoes?
Do you know anyone who likes to buy a lot of shoes?
Have you ever bought shoes online?
How often do you buy shoes?

specific.title: 9. Advertisements
questions: Are there many advertisements in your country?
Why do you think there are so many advertisements now?
What are the various places where we see advertisements?
How do you feel about advertisements?

specific.title: 10. Secondary school
questions: Where do you go to school?
Do you think your school is good for every student?
What changes do you want to make in your school?

specific.title: 11. Rubbish / Recycling
questions: Do you recycle now? Why?
Did you recycle when you were a kid?
Will you recycle in the future?
What kind of things do you recycle?

specific.title: 12. Remembering names
questions: Is it easy for you to remember names?
Will you forget other people's names if others forget your name?
How can you strengthen your memory?

specific.title: 13. Tiredness
questions: Do you often feel tired?
When would you feel tired?
What do you do when you feel tired?
Do you think you get enough rest?

specific.title: 14. Glasses
questions: Do people in your country wear sunglasses?
Where can you buy sunglasses?
Do you like to wear sunglasses?

specific.title: 15. Food
questions: What kinds of meals do you like?
Do you often have dinner with your family or friends?
When do you usually eat dinner?
Are there any fruits or vegetables you don't like? Why?
What is your favourite cuisine?

specific.title: 16. Headphones
questions: Is wearing headphones comfortable?
Do you use headphones?
What type of headphones do you use?
When would you use headphones?
In what conditions would you not use headphones?

specific.title: 17. Watches
questions: How often do you wear a watch?
What was your first watch like?
What kind of watches do you like to wear?
Do people still wear watches in your country?
Did you receive any watch as a gift when you were a child?

specific.title: 18. Cars / Driving
questions: Will you buy an expensive car in the future?
Do you think car colours are important?
Did you enjoy travelling by car when you were a kid?
What types of cars do you like?
Do you prefer to be a driver or the passenger?
What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?

specific.title: 19. Websites
questions: What kinds of websites do you usually use?
What changes compared to the past?

specific.title: 20. Mirrors
questions: Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror? How often?
Have you ever bought mirrors?
Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?

specific.title: 21. Parks
questions: Did you like going to parks as a child?
Do you still like going to parks now?
Would you like to see more parks in your city?
Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
Would you prefer to play in a personal garden or public garden?
How are the parks today different from those you visited as a kid?
What do you like to do when visiting a park?
Would you like to play in a public garden or park?

specific.title: 22. Shopping
questions: Do you like going shopping?
Do you shop online?
Does shopping take you a lot of time?
What is the best part about shopping?

specific.title: 23. Keeping things tidy
questions: Are you a tidy person?
Are all of your family members tidy?
Are you tidier at home or at work/school?

specific.title: 24. Music
questions: Do you like listening to music?
When do you listen to music?
Did you learn instruments?
Did you have any music classes in school?
Do you think it is necessary for children to have music classes?
What do you think of Vietnamese traditional music?
How much time do you spend listening to music every day?
What is your favorite kind of music?
When did you start listening to this type of music?
How do you feel when you listen to music?

specific.title: 25. Teachers
questions: Do you like any teacher of yours?
Do you still keep in touch with your teachers?
Do you think it's important to like your teacher?
Do you want to be a teacher?
What qualities should a good teacher have?
Do you have a favorite teacher?

specific.title: 26. Social Media
questions: Do you like to use social media?
Do you think you or your friends use too much social media?
Do you want to work in social media? Why?
What's the most popular social media in Vietnam? Why?

specific.title: 27. Clothes
questions: What's your favorite color of clothes?
What kind of clothes do you never wear?
What kind of clothes do you usually wear?
Do you wear the same style of clothes on weekdays and weekends?

specific.title: 28. Films
questions: What's your favourite kind of movie?
Did you go to the cinema a lot when you were a child?
Which is more popular in your country, going to the cinema or watching movies at home?

specific.title: 29. Dreams
questions: How long can you remember your dream when you wake up?
Do you like hearing about other people's dreams?
Do you think dreams can affect your life?
Do you often have dreams at night?
Have you had a bad dream before?
What was the strangest dream you have had?
What do you usually dream about?

specific.title: 30. City
questions: Would you recommend your city to others?
What's the weather like where you live?
Are there people of different ages living in this city?
Are the people friendly in the city?
Is the city friendly to children and old people?
Do you often see your neighbors?
What city do you live in?
Do you like this city? Why?
How long have you lived in this city?
Are there big changes in this city?

specific.title: 31. Outer Space
questions: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?

specific.title: 32. Art
questions: Do you like art?
Have you ever visited an art gallery?
Is there any art work on the wall in your room?

specific.title: 33. Singing
questions: Do you often sing?
When do you like to sing?
Is it difficult to sing well?
Do you want to be a singer?
What kinds of music do you like to sing?

specific.title: 34. Evening
questions: Do you prefer studying in the morning or in the afternoon?
What do you usually do in the evening?
What did you do in the evening when you were little? Why?
Are there any differences between what you do in the evening now and what you did in the past?

specific.title: 35. Old Buildings
questions: Have you ever seen some old buildings in the city?
Do you think we should keep old buildings in cities?
Do you prefer living in an old building or a modern house?

specific.title: 36. Sports
questions: Did you do any sport when you were younger? (Why/Why not?)
Have you ever supported a sports team? (Why/Why not?)
Do you enjoy watching sports? (Why/Why not?)
Do you think there is too much sport on television in your country? (Why/Why not?)

specific.title: 37. Science
questions: Do you like science?
What science have you studied?
How do you study science?
What's the most difficult part of studying science?
How has the science that you have studied helped you?

specific.title: 38. Comedy/Jokes
questions: Do you like watching movies that make you laugh?
Do you find it easy to make others laugh?
Do you think it's a good thing if you always make others laugh?

specific.title: 39. History
questions: Do you like learning history?
What historical event do you find most interesting?
Do you think history is important?
Do you like to watch programmes on TV about history?
Do you think the internet is a good place to learn about history?

specific.title: 40. Morning Routine
questions: Do you like to get up early in the morning?
What do you do in the morning?
What is your morning routine?
Is breakfast important?

specific.title: 41. Study/Subject
questions: Describe your education.
What is your area of specialization?
Why did you choose to study that major?
What kind of school did you go to as a child?
What was your favourite subject as a child?
Do you think your country has an effective education system?
Are you looking forward to working?

specific.title: 42. Home/Accommodation
questions: What kind of housing/accommodation do you live in?
Who do you live with?
How long have you lived there?
What's the difference between where you are living now and where you have lived in the past?
Do you plan to live there for a long time?
Which room does your family spend most of the time in?
Are the transport facilities to your home very good?
Do you prefer living in a house or a flat?
What part of your home do you like the most?

specific.title: 43. Hometown
questions: Do you like living there?
Do you think you will continue living there for a long time?
Please describe your hometown a little.
What's your hometown famous for?
Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?
Are there many young people in your hometown?
Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?

specific.title: 44. Neighborhood/Area
questions: Do you know your neighbors?
What do you think of your neighbors?
How do you get along well with your neighbors?

part2_3.cueCard: 1. Describe a person you only met once recently and want to know more about
bullets: Why you want to know more about him/her
And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: What can we do to leave a good impression on people we meet for the first time?
What should we not talk about when we meet a person for the first time?
How do people make friends in your country?
On what occasions do people like to make friends?
Is it important to have the same hobbies and interests when making friends?
What qualities make true friends?

part2_3.cueCard: 2. Describe a gift you would like to buy for your friend
bullets: How long you have known him/her
How you would choose a gift for him/her
And explain why you would choose that gift for him/her
part3: When do people normally send gifts to others?
Is it easy to choose clothes as gifts?
Will people feel happy when receiving an expensive gift?

part2_3.cueCard: 3. Describe a time when you changed an important decision of yours
bullets: And explain how you felt about the experience
part3: When do most children begin to make their own decisions?

part2_3.cueCard: 4. Describe a famous person in your local area
bullets: And explain how you feel about this person
part3: Is it always good to be a popular student at school?
Why are some students popular?

part2_3.cueCard: 5. Describe a time you made an important decision and were happy with the result
bullets: How easy it was for you to make the decision
And explain why you were happy with the result
part3: How can we tell the difference between an important and an easy decision?
Do you think it is a good idea to make a small decision every day?
What little decisions do people make every day?
What if people in a group have different opinions on a decision?
Do you think most people's decisions are made in their 20s?
Which is better, to make a decision quickly or slowly?

part2_3.cueCard: 6. Describe a person you know who did something difficult and was successful
bullets: What difficult thing this person did
And explain how you feel about this person
part3: Is it difficult to do business in today's world?
How can companies help protect the environment?
Does money equal success?

part2_3.cueCard: 7. Describe a course that impressed you a lot
bullets: What you did during the course
And explain why it impressed you a lot
part3: What do people need to remember in their daily lives?
What can we learn from history?
Why do some people have a better memory than others?
Do people like things of memorial significance?
Which can help people remember things better, words or photos?
Can technology help people remember things better? How?

part2_3.cueCard: 8. Describe a time when someone talked about something you were not interested in but you kept listening
bullets: And explain how you feel about the experience
part3: What kind of topics do young people like to talk about today?
What would happen if the listener didn't listen carefully?
How can we tell if a listener is listening carefully?

part2_3.cueCard: 9. Describe a person you know who really likes taking photos
bullets: When and how you got to know him/her
And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: Why are some people keen on taking photos?
What kind of photos do people often take?
Do you think it's OK to take photos everywhere?
Why do tourists like taking photos while they are travelling?
Some people don't mind others walking into their shot when they're taking photos. What do you think?

part2_3.cueCard: 10. Describe a new skill you learned when you were a child
bullets: And explain how you feel about learning the skill
part3: What skills should children learn before they go to school?
What are the differences between learning in a group and learning by yourself?
What are the differences between the way adults learn and the way children learn?
Do you think it is easier for children to learn new skills than for adults?
Can a child learn skills from another child?
Is it important for everyone to have a specialized skill?

part2_3.cueCard: 11. Describe a time when you saved money to buy something you wanted
bullets: Why you wanted to buy it
How you saved money for it
And explain how you feel after buying it
part3: Should schools teach children how to manage money from a young age?
Should parents teach their children to spend money freely or to save money?
Do you think it is easier to teach teenagers how to manage money when they are around 16 or 17 years old?
Is it easier to spend money or save money?
What kind of things do people usually save money for?

part2_3.cueCard: 12. Describe a person you know who is very organized
bullets: What this person usually does to stay organized
In what situations you have noticed this quality
And explain why you think being organized is important to him/her
part3: Why is it important for people to be organized?
Do you think children should learn to be organized from a young age?
Are organized people more likely to be successful at work or in their studies?
What can people do to become more organized?
Should parents teach their children to be organized?
Do you think it is important for managers to be organized?

part2_3.cueCard: 13. Describe a time when you interviewed a famous person
bullets: When and where you interviewed this person
What you talked about during the interview
And explain how you feel about the experience
part3: What kinds of people are usually interviewed?
Why do some people dislike being interviewed?
Why do some people think interviews are a waste of time?
What should people do to prepare for a job interview?

part2_3.cueCard: 14. Describe a happy person you know
bullets: And explain why you think he/she is a happy person
part3: Should teachers know what children are doing all the time?
Do you think teachers are able to spot the unhappy children?
How can the arts spread positive emotions in society?
When do you think people are happiest?

part2_3.cueCard: 15. Describe your least favourite movie
bullets: And explain why it's your least favourite movie
part3: What kinds of movies are the most popular in Vietnam?
What are the differences between watching movies at home and in a cinema?
Are movies more likely to help people become more creative than books?
Can movies help people better understand the cultural background of a country?

part2_3.cueCard: 16. Describe a person who learns history and loves history
bullets: And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: Do you think children should begin learning history from an early age?
At what age do you think people should begin to learn history?
How do children learn history before they attend school?
Is it important to learn how people in the past lived their lives?
Do you think people should learn ancient history before learning modern history?
Besides historical events, what else is important when learning history?

part2_3.cueCard: 17. Describe an enjoyable evening you had with your friends
bullets: Who you spent the evening with
And explain why it was enjoyable
part3: How do people get along in a big family?

part2_3.cueCard: 18. Describe a person who is good at making things by hand
bullets: What materials or technologies he/she uses
And why you think this person is good at making things by hand
part3: Do you think handmade is a good thing?
Do you think children like making things by hand?
Is traditional craftsmanship important to the country's industry?
What kinds of handmade things did you make as a child?
What can handmade products bring to tourist attractions?

part2_3.cueCard: 19. Describe a natural place in your city that you enjoy visiting
bullets: Who you often go there with
And explain why you enjoy visiting there
part3: Do you think there should be many natural places in cities?
Do you think staying in a natural place would help change people's mood?
Which is more important, protecting the environment or developing the economy?

part2_3.cueCard: 20. Describe a noisy place you have been to
bullets: And explain why you feel it's a noisy place

part2_3.cueCard: 21. Describe someone who is older than you that you admire
bullets: What kinds of things you like to do together
And explain how you feel about this person
part3: What can young and old people learn from each other?
Has old people's life quality improved when compared to the past?
Why is there a generation gap between the young and the old?
What do old people usually do in their daily life?

part2_3.cueCard: 22. Describe an activity you do regularly that you think is a waste of time
bullets: And explain why you think it is a waste of time
part3: How do you balance life and work?
Will you continue doing something when you are aware that it's a waste of time?
What kinds of things make people feel pressured?
Why do some people refuse to abide by rules?

part2_3.cueCard: 23. Describe a crowded place you went to
bullets: And how you felt about it

part2_3.cueCard: 24. Describe a time when you received good service in a shop/store
bullets: When you went to the shop
What service you received from the staff
And explain how you felt about the service
part3: What are the differences between the service in large shops and small stores?
What do people do when they get bad service?
What are the qualities of being a good restaurant?

part2_3.cueCard: 25. Describe a city you have been to and would like to visit again
bullets: And explain why you would like to visit it again
part3: What's the difference between the city and the countryside?
Some people say large cities are suitable for old people. What do you think?
Do you think it is possible that all of the population move to cities?
Do you think people in the countryside are friendlier than people in the city?
Are there any changes in your city?
What should the government do to improve citizens' safety?

part2_3.cueCard: 26. Describe a place where you don't like the music they play
bullets: What kind of music they play there
And explain why you don't like the music they play there
part3: Do you think music is important in public places?
What kind of music do people usually listen to in cafés?
Why do some people like listening to music while studying or working?
Do young people and older people have different tastes in music?
Is it a good idea for shops to play music?
Should restaurants allow customers to choose the music?
Can music affect people's behaviour?
Do you think people listen to too much music nowadays?

part2_3.cueCard: 27. Describe an experience that you were proud of
bullets: And explain why you were proud of it
part3: What kinds of achievements make people feel proud?
Do young people feel proud of the same things as older people?
Is it important for parents to praise their children?
Why do some people find it difficult to accept praise?
Do you think people should be proud of their achievements?
Is it better to be proud of yourself or to receive recognition from others?
Can being too proud of yourself have negative effects?
What can people learn from experiences that make them proud?

part2_3.cueCard: 28. Describe a quiet place that you would love to go to
bullets: How you know about this place
Who you would like to go there with
And explain why you would like to go there
part3: Why do people like going to quiet places?
What kinds of places are usually quiet?
Do people nowadays have enough opportunities to enjoy peace and quiet?
Why is it difficult for people to find quiet places in cities?
Do young people prefer quiet places or lively places?
Is it important for children to spend time in quiet places?

part2_3.cueCard: 29. Describe a long trip that you often take but do not like
bullets: Why you often have to make this trip
And explain why you do not like it
part3: Why do people dislike long journeys?
What are the most common reasons people make long trips?
Do people prefer travelling by car, train or plane for long journeys?
What can people do to make a long journey more enjoyable?
Why do some people enjoy travelling while others do not?
Do you think travelling by public transport will become more popular in the future?

part2_3.cueCard: 30. Describe a party that was held after a special event
bullets: What you did at the party
And explain why you remember this party
part3: Why do people like having parties after special events?
What kinds of events do people usually celebrate with a party?
Do people prefer large parties or small gatherings?
What makes a party enjoyable?
Why are some people reluctant to attend parties?
Do you think people spend too much money on parties?

part2_3.cueCard: 31. Describe a change that you made recently
bullets: What you did for the change
And explain how you feel about the change
part3: Is it easier for young people to change?
Is it easy for old people to change?
How can people change their daily routine if they want to?
What are the disadvantages when people keep making changes?

part2_3.cueCard: 32. Describe a time when you changed an important opinion of yours
bullets: And explain how you felt about the experience
part3: Why do people change their opinions?
Is it easy for people to admit they were wrong?
Do older people change their opinions less often than young people?
Can other people influence our opinions? How?
Is it important to listen to different viewpoints?
Should people always stick to their own opinions?

part2_3.cueCard: 33. Describe a law on environmental protection
bullets: How you first learned about it
And explain how you feel about this law
part3: What kinds of rules do schools in Vietnam have?
Do you think school rules are important?
Are children unhappy with the school rules?
How can parents help their children understand and follow rules?
What are the rules people should obey at work?
What is the purpose of punishment?

part2_3.cueCard: 34. Describe a long-term goal/ambition you would like to achieve
bullets: How long you have had this goal/ambition
And explain why you set it
part3: What kinds of ambitions do people have?
Why should parents encourage children to have ambitions?
Should parents interfere with children's ambitions?
Is there any difference between children's ambitions and those of grown-ups?

part2_3.cueCard: 35. Describe a time when you sent a message or an email to someone but received no reply for a long time
bullets: Whether you finally received the reply
And explain how you felt about the experience
part3: Do you think children are born smart or they learn to become smart?
How do children become smarter at school?
Why are some people well-rounded and others only good at one thing?
Why does modern society need talents of all kinds?

part2_3.cueCard: 36. Describe a story/book with animals in it
bullets: And explain what you think of this story/book
part3: Why do children enjoy stories about animals?
What can people learn from animal stories?
Do films influence how people view animals?
Why are animals often used in stories?
Should children learn about animals at school?
Do people care more about animal welfare nowadays?

part2_3.cueCard: 37. Describe an advertisement with a famous person in it
bullets: And explain how you feel about the advertisement
part3: Why do companies use celebrities in advertisements?
Do celebrity advertisements influence consumers?
Are advertisements more creative nowadays?
What makes an advertisement effective?
Do children get influenced by advertisements easily?
Should there be stricter control of advertising?

part2_3.cueCard: 38. Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others
bullets: What you saw and did there
And explain why you would like to recommend it to others
part3: Is it important to take photos while traveling?
Can you trust other people's travel journals on the Internet?
What factors affect how people feel about travel?

part2_3.cueCard: 39. Describe a challenging technological problem you faced
bullets: When and where you faced it
And explain how you solved it
part3: What kinds of technological problems do people often face?
How has technology made people's lives easier?
Do you think people depend too much on technology nowadays?
What should people do when technology fails?
Will technology become more reliable in the future?

part2_3.cueCard: 40. Describe a person who is good at learning and speaking new languages
bullets: How you got to know him/her
How he/she learns a new language
And explain how you feel about him/her
part3: At what age should children start learning a foreign language?
Which skill is more important, speaking or writing?
Does a person still need to learn other languages if he or she is good at English?
Do you think minority languages will disappear?

part2_3.cueCard: 41. Describe a food that people eat on special occasions/events
bullets: And explain why people eat it on that special occasion/event
part3: Do Vietnamese people grow plants?
Which food is generally popular in your country?
Why do some people prefer planting food themselves?
Will there be more and more people planting food in the future?

part2_3.cueCard: 42. Describe a live sports event you watched and liked
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain why you liked it
part3: What kinds of sports events are broadcast on TV or other media in your country?
Do people in your country enjoy watching football games?
Does encouragement and applause from the audience have an impact on athletes? What are the impacts?

part2_3.cueCard: 43. Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse)
bullets: When he/she started to think about that
What he/she would like to do
And explain why he/she would like to choose this career
part3: Why do some people choose to work in the medical field?
How does working in a medical-related profession impact a person's life?
Do you think medical professionals are valued in society?
In your opinion, which profession is more important: doctors or nurses?
How can technology influence medical-related professions in the future?
What qualities are essential for someone to succeed in a medical profession?

part2_3.cueCard: 44. Describe a time when you worked in a group
bullets: And explain how you felt about working in the group
part3: How do other people in your team think he is?
What do you think are the characteristics of a good leader?
What happens if you don't have a good leader?
Why do some people not like teamwork?
Do you think young people are suitable for teamwork?

part2_3.cueCard: 45. Describe a person you know who has a successful business
bullets: How you got to know him/her
Why and how he/she started the business
And explain why you think the business is successful
part3: Would you like to start a family business?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of family businesses?

part2_3.cueCard: 46. Describe a person who loves to grow plants (e.g. vegetables, flowers) at home or in the garden
bullets: And explain why he/she loves growing plants
part3: What do you think of the job of a farmer?
Are there many people growing their own vegetables now?
Do you think it's good to let kids learn how to plant?
What are the differences between traditional and modern agriculture?

part2_3.cueCard: 47. Describe an interesting video
bullets: When and where you watched it
And explain how you feel about it
part3: What kinds of things are popular on social media?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of using social media?
What do you think of making friends on social network?
